salary_details.details: The notice mentions no allowances. The application form's declaration says the post is purely temporary on a contractual basis under the National Health Mission – Tamil Nadu and that services will not be regularized for any reason.

how_to_apply: Download the application form and vacancy details from the NHM-TN website (https://nhm.tn.gov.in) or the Greater Chennai Corporation website (www.chennaicorporation.gov.in). The form is also printed on pages 3 and 4 of the notice.

Fill in the form: name, father's name, date of birth, age, gender, qualification, institution, council registration number, addresses, Aadhar number, phone number, email ID if available, community, SSLC and HSC marks, and the percentage in GNM / B.Sc.
Attach a passport size photograph in the space on the form.
Enclose one set of self-attested photocopies of the documents listed below, with two recent passport size colour photographs.
Sign and date the declaration at the end of the form.

Send the application to The City Health Officer/Member Secretary, Chennai City Urban Health Mission, Public Health Department, 3rd floor Amma Maaligai, Ripon Buildings, EVR Periyar Salai, Chennai – 600 003. It must reach there by 5:00 PM on 7 December 2026.
Evidence of date of birth (Birth Certificate / SSLC / HSC certificate)
Evidence of educational qualification (Diploma / B.Sc. Degree certificate)
Mark sheets of SSLC, HSC and Degree/Diploma (all semester mark sheets)
Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council registration certificate
Evidence for Tamil eligibility (10th or 12th standard marks)
Community Certificate issued by the Revenue Department
Proof of residency: Voter ID, Aadhar Card or Ration Card
Certificate of character and conduct issued by a Group A or Group B Officer working in Government, issued within 3 months prior to the notification
If applicable, certificate of Transgender / Deserted wife / Ex-Serviceman / Destitute widow issued by the competent authority
Any other special records of significance from competent authorities, as indicated in the selection criteria mentioned
important_instructions: The engagement is on contract basis, purely temporary in nature, as per NHM norms, through the concerned District Health Societies/City Health Society. The number of vacancies is an estimate and is likely to change. The application and self-attested document copies must reach the address by 07.12.2026, 5:00 PM. For clarification, call 044 – 2561 9330, +91 94451 90744 or +91 94459 10934 during office hours.

content_sections.heading: About Chennai City Urban Health Mission
content_sections.text: Chennai City Urban Health Mission works under Greater Chennai Corporation and is the body that issued this notice from the Public Health Department, Ripon Buildings, Chennai. The notice is signed by its Member Secretary. It acts as the City Health Society for engaging contract staff under the National Health Mission – Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q1. How many Staff Nurse vacancies are there in Chennai City Urban Health Mission?
faq.answer: The notice shows 130 vacancies, marked as an estimated number that is likely to change.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Filled applications must reach the office of the City Health Officer / Chennai City Urban Health Mission by 5:00 PM on 07.12.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: GNM / B.Sc. Nursing from a Government or Government approved Private Nursing College, recognised by the university approved under state norms. Valid registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council is also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 50 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for age.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly pay of the Staff Nurse?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration is Rs.21,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Download the form from the NHM-TN or Greater Chennai Corporation website, fill it in, and enclose self-attested copies of the documents with two passport size colour photographs. The application must reach The City Health Officer/Member Secretary, Chennai City Urban Health Mission, Public Health Department, 3rd floor Amma Maaligai, Ripon Buildings, EVR Periyar Salai, Chennai – 600 003 by the last date.

faq.question: Q7. Is the Staff Nurse job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is on contract basis, purely temporary in nature. The form's declaration says services will not be regularized for any reason.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Staff Nurses work?
faq.answer: They will work in CEmONC institutions, including SNCU and PICU, under the Directorate of Medical and Rural Health Services and the Directorate of Medical Education & Research.

faq.question: Q9. Which certificates are needed for Tamil eligibility and character?
faq.answer: Evidence for Tamil eligibility is the 10th or 12th standard marks. A character and conduct certificate from a Group A or Group B Government Officer, issued within 3 months prior to the notification, is needed from all applicants.

faq.question: Q10. Whom can I call for clarification?
faq.answer: The notice gives the phone numbers 044 – 2561 9330, +91 94451 90744 and +91 94459 10934, to be called during office hours.
